breakdown.description: Ideal-gas normal-shock relations are applied to liquid water without a valid equation of state/model.
breakdown.reason: The Agent did not address the fundamental inconsistency of applying ideal-gas normal-shock relations to water (a liquid). It did not flag that water is incompatible with these relations, nor did it suggest correcting the fluid to 'air' as the ground truth indicates. Instead, it simply asked for an upstream temperature, implicitly accepting the flawed premise.
